message.horrormod.quill_reveal: A piece of forbidden knowledge sears into your mind...
message.horrormod.quill_silent: The quill has nothing left to reveal.
message.horrormod.rift_no_surface: The rift needs something solid to tear open against.
message.horrormod.rift_no_space: There isn't enough room here for a rift.
gui.horrormod.journal.title: Worn Journal
journal.horrormod.blood_pool.title: Blood Pool
journal.horrormod.blood_pool.description: A pool of blood left behind by something. Purely cosmetic, but unsettling to find.
journal.horrormod.laceration.title: Laceration
journal.horrormod.laceration.description: A wound that won't stop bleeding. Deals damage over time like poison, and leaves blood pools behind at your feet.
journal.horrormod.blood_soaked_quill.des: A ritualist's quill, made from the bones of the otherworld and the finest feathers. Writing with it costs blood, but reveals secrets nothing else will.
journal.horrormod.the_otherworld.title: The Otherworld
journal.horrormod.the_otherworld.descrip: Something bleeds through from beyond, thin as it is. The pools left behind are not blood as we know it, and whatever bled it has been gone a long time.
journal.horrormod.the_ritualists.title: The Ritualists
journal.horrormod.the_ritualists.descrip: Before the pools, there were those who sought them out on purpose. Their quills still remember what they were used for, even if the hands that held them do not.
journal.horrormod.otherworld_stone.title: Otherworld Stone
journal.horrormod.otherworld_stone.descr: Stone from somewhere that isn't here. It's colder than it should be, and doesn't echo right when struck.
journal.horrormod.otherworld_ground.desc: The surface soil of the Otherworld. Nothing grows in it, and nothing seems to be trying to.
journal.horrormod.otherworld.title: The Otherworld
journal.horrormod.otherworld.description: An ethereal dimension accessed through devotion and sacrifice, inhabited by beasts beyond your wildest imagination. For now, it stands empty -- whatever lived here left long before you arrived.
journal.horrormod.ritualistic_dagger.des: Devotion and sacrifice, made practical. Strike the ground with this and pay its blood price to tear open a fissure to the Otherworld -- it won't stay open long, and it takes the same price to open one back.
journal.horrormod.ritual_circle.title: Ritual Circle
journal.horrormod.ritual_circle.descript: An obelisk ringed by spires, exactly as the Ritualists keep it. The blood pooled at its base didn't come from the Otherworld on its own -- someone still brings it here on purpose.
journal.horrormod.cultist_crossbow.title: Cultist Crossbow
journal.horrormod.cultist_crossbow.descr: Carried by half the Ritualists you'll find at a circle. Functions like any crossbow -- the violet binding is decoration, not enchantment.
journal.horrormod.cultist_axe.title: Cultist Axe
journal.horrormod.cultist_axe.descriptio: An iron axe, bound in cord the color of dried blood. The other half of the Ritualists carry these instead of crossbows.
journal.horrormod.cultist.title: Cultist
journal.horrormod.cultist.description: The Ritualists themselves -- not gone, not descendants, still keeping their circles. They leave you alone unless you start something; they won't leave each other alone once you do.
